title: Chess.com Reached 200 Million Accounts After The Release Spike
hook: One television release turned chess into a lasting online habit.
closing: Chess attention spiked once, but the account totals kept climbing long afterward.
question: What pulled you into chess?

segments.say: Chess.com reached 200 million registered accounts, showing the audience kept growing years after the spike.
Chess.com signups reached 2.8 million in one month, accelerating growth already underway.
Chess.com accounts reached 200 million, roughly one-third of estimated regular players worldwide.
